definitions.explanation: a document issued by schools showing a student's grades and evaluations for each subject

examples.japanese: {通知表|つうちひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
{通知表|つうちひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧。
examples.english: Show the report card to my parents.

examples.japanese: {今学期|こんがっき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{通知表|つうちひょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がっていた→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: My grades had improved on this term's report card.

notes:
JAPANESE EDUCATION SYSTEM:
{通知表|つうちひょう} is typically given at the end of each term (⟦{学期|がっき}→学期：01073_gakki⟧).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{成績表|せいせきひょう}→成績表：09289_seisekihyou⟧ - grades report
- ⟦{通信簿|つうしんぼ}→通信簿：19506_tsuushinbo⟧ - report card (older term)

GRADING SYSTEMS:
- Elementary school: Often 3-level (⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧/⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧/⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧すこし or ◎/○/△)
- Junior high: Often 5-level (1-5)
- High school: Often 10-point scale

- {出席日数|しゅっせきにっすう} - attendance record
